# Weather App 🌤️

A serverless weather application built with Azure Functions and JavaScript.

## Features

- Real time weather data for any city
- Temperature, humidity, and weather conditions
- Built with Azure Functions (serverless)
- Integrated with OpenWeatherMap API

## Tech Stack

- Azure Functions
- JavaScript (Node.js)
- OpenWeatherMap API
- HTML/CSS Frontend

## Live Demo

[Weather App](https://weatherapp-antaa.azurewebsites.net/api/WeatherFunction?city=Mumbai)
